function.name: cari_ternak
function.description: Look up animals in the farm's herd by ear tag (exact or partial). Call this first whenever the farmer mentions an ear tag, to confirm it exists and get its sex and reproductive status before recording anything.

ear_tag.description: Ear tag as spoken by the farmer, e.g. '0266' or 'T201199'

function.name: catat_birahi
function.description: Record an observed estrus (birahi) in a female. Only call when the farmer says the animal showed heat signs. Do not call for mating.

waktu.description: ISO 8601 local date-time of the observation. Resolve 'tadi pagi', 'this morning', 'kemarin sore' using the current time given in the system prompt. If only the date is known, use T08:00 and set waktu_perkiraan=true.

waktu_perkiraan.description: true if the time was estimated rather than stated

tanda.description: Heat signs mentioned by the farmer, if any (red/swollen/warm vulva, bleating, restlessness)

ada_pejantan.description: Whether a ram/teaser was present, if mentioned

function.name: catat_kawin
function.description: Record a mating (kawin). This is day zero of the reproductive calendar. The ram's ear tag is required; if the farmer did not say which ram, ask before calling.

pejantan.description: The ram's ear tag, or the semen/straw code for artificial insemination

metode.description: alam = natural mating, ib = artificial insemination. Default alam unless the farmer says IB/inseminasi.

cara_diketahui.description: How the mating was detected, if mentioned

function.name: catat_cek_bunting
function.description: Record a pregnancy check result (USG, palpation, or non-return to estrus around day 17-21).

jumlah_janin.description: Only if stated by the examiner

pemeriksa.description: Name of the vet or technician, if mentioned

function.name: catat_beranak
function.description: Record a lambing (beranak). Creates one new animal record per live lamb with dam set to ear_tag and sire taken from the last recorded mating. Ask for the number born if not stated; ask for the time if only a vague period was given (e.g. 'semalam').

jumlah_mati.description: Lambs born dead or died shortly after. 0 if the farmer says all are alive; ask if unclear.

anak.description: Details of each live lamb if the farmer gave them (sex, ear tag, birth weight). Leave empty if not stated; do not invent.

function.name: catat_sapih
function.description: Record weaning (sapih) of lambs from a dam, optionally with weaning weights.

ear_tag.description: The dam's ear tag, or a lamb's ear tag if the farmer refers to the lamb

function.name: catat_bcs
function.description: Record a body condition score (BCS) on the 1-5 scale, half points allowed.

function.name: larang_kawin
function.description: Mark an animal as not to be bred (larangan kawin), with a reason, or lift an existing ban.
